newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 flat in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 flat in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were flat in slow late trading on Thursday as most players sitting on the sidelines waiting for fresh leads, dealers said.
Dealers said January SIR20 offer prices remained at 55.50-56.00 cents fob Medan, 55.25-55.75 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang, 54.50-55.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
One Medan dealer said SIR3CV was steady following recent U.S. enquiries for January-December shipments next year. SIR3CV was last traded at 141 cents/kg.
Dealers said prompt delivery latex was on offer at 2,150 rupiah/kg against the previous 2,200 rupiah due to weak demand.
